Main Flame characteristics
•
Flame height was shown to not be affected by a change in gravity field.
•
Flame width was affected by producing a thinner plume as it was expected. 
•
Detachment with the burner tip was observed numerically and it might be 
attributed to the numerical challenge of these boundary conditions.
•
The new combination of chemical kinetic model proposed containing excited 
species and ions has shown to predict important characteristics of the non-
premixed methane laminar jet flame.
CH* chemiluminescence
•
CH* profiles showed a brighter flame while going to higher gravity 
environments (hypergravity conditions).
Ions
•
High concentration of H3O+ produced and transported far away from the 
flame.
•
Higher concentration of naturally produced ions has been observed under 
hypergravity conditions. The electric field effect could be increased under 
strong gravity environments.
